【原视频简介】
We had 24 hours and a slightly questionable idea: build an AI app that looks at your physique and gives you a completely honest rating.

We planned everything in Canva, used ChatGPT and Codex to work through the logic, then built the app with Claude Code. Once it finally worked, we tested it on ourselves and it was much more brutal than expected... 😭

This video is more of a relaxed build vlog than our usual tutorials. You’ll see the planning, broken first attempt, app walkthrough, our real results, and everything we changed afterward to make it genuinely useful.
We’re also building a community where we’ll share our projects, source files and future builds. More on that soon.
